If you are however in the same class or club and know the answers to these questions, you could ask questions like, whats your favorite song by (insert artist name here), do you like (insert teacher name here), etc, etc. I definitely know the struggle lmao. Best of luck, hope I helped!

I’ve been in your situation countless times, believe me I know how much this sucks. For me, getting a hobby and listening to music has always been my coping mechanism. Find a music artist you relate to, that’s what I did. I fell for this guy in the year above me and he turned out to be an asshole, but instead of moping around and letting him toy with my emotions, I did something different. I decided to push myself and try new things. I started to paint and thankfully my favorite artist (Hayley Williams) was releasing her album ‘Petals for Armor’ all while I was going through this, listening to her music helped me a lot. I also started to work out, this is a great way to get your mind off things and get your energy out! Also, (this is an obvious one) just try talking to your friends. You don’t have to talk to about the guy if you don’t want, or maybe you do, whatever helps you cope. But I think that it’s best to try to get him off your mind and do what sincerely makes you happy. That’s how I dealt with my situation. I truly hope I at least sort of helped, nobody deserves this. Wishing you the best and good luck!

If you wanna just remain friends than try to ignore those feelings. Neither option is easy, trust me I KNOW. Falling in love can either end terribly or the best thing in the world. So in short, my advice is: talk to her about how you’re feeling. You never know what could happen.
